question_text: How many distinct object_id values were tracked at Gate_MainEntrance across all entry/exit events on 2025-12-08 (UTC)?
answer_text: There were 2,951 distinct object_id values tracked at Gate_MainEntrance on 2025-12-08 (UTC).

citations.cypher:
MATCH (e:Event)-[:DETECTED_BY]->(:Camera)-[:LOCATED_AT]->(:Location {name: 'Gate_MainEntrance'})
WHERE e.timestamp_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND e.timestamp_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
RETURN count(DISTINCT e.object_id) AS distinct_object_ids_tracked
